appUpdate.changelog:
What's New
🚀 New Features
- iOS Remote Soundboard Controls: Added soundboard buttons to the iOS Remote! You can now trigger and control the Mini Soundboard directly from your remote device. (Smart Link Remote app coming soon!)
- Expanded Mini Soundboard: Added 4 new soundpads to the Mini Soundboard—more sounds, more fun!
⚡ Improvements & Optimizations
- MIDI Engine Optimization: Improved overall performance and stability. The engine now defaults to 198 polyphony and a 44,100 Hz sample rate.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Animated GIF Banners: Fixed an issue where using an animated GIF in the banner caused heavy graphics rendering lag and misaligned the banner to the top-left corner instead of centering it on the screen.
- TouchKeypad Navigation (the right-side touch keypad panel on landscape): Fixed TouchKeypad panel input issues when pressing number keys using a handheld remote (pressing the next number plays the song unexpectedly). (Tip: For the best experience, we recommend using the Smart Link app or iOS Remote.)
